simple.meaning: עִצָּבוֹן (ʻitstsâbôwn) is a Hebrew object word meaning “worrisomeness , i.e. labor or pain.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 3:16. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עִצָּבוֹן (H6093) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עִצָּבוֹן (ʻitstsâbôwn) / H6093 is traced through Genesis 3:16, Genesis 3:17, Genesis 5:29 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H6093. itstsabon עִצָּבוֺן noun [masculine] pain, toil ; — ׳ע absolute Gen 3:17 toil ; construct יָדֵינוּ עִצְּבוֺן 5:29 (both of agriculture); suffix עִצְּבוֺנֵךְ 3:16 (of travail; all J).

occurrences.englishText: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”
